en: The image shows an elevated view of a park or public square with landscaped gardens, fountains, a central modernist building, several paths, and people walking around. There are mountains in the distant background, a small red car in the lower corner, and a few characteristic two-story buildings with Mediterranean-style roofs. The overall look is mid-20th-century, with lush greenery and some organized geometric patterns in the landscaping.
